title: School Girls Club Women Group, 1947 Vintage B&W Snapshot Photo
back_text_transcription: For Clara: May. 15: 1947 / School Girls Club. at Marjorie / 3 9 5
description: A black and white snapshot taken on May 15, 1947, depicting a group portrait of women standing and kneeling outdoors near a wooden building and leafy trees. Inscribed on the reverse as the 'School Girls Club at Marjorie', the image shows members of a longstanding women's club or alumni group wearing popular 1940s fashions, including patterned dresses, coats, and hats.
